model.title: Five levels. One honest score.
model.lead: The Niticore Governance Readiness™ model places your organisation on a 0 to 100 scale, from reactive to adaptive. Each step is as wide as its score band.

levels.name: Emerging
levels.traits: Teams use AI without central visibility. Unknown vendor APIs and shadow LLMs spread, and issues are handled ad hoc.

levels.name: Defined
levels.traits: An initial AI inventory is assembled. Written policies and ethical guidelines exist in static documents, but enforcement is voluntary and siloed.
levels.platform: Documented on paper, disconnected in practice.

levels.name: Operational
levels.traits: Governance processes are integrated into development and deployment pipelines. Evidence is generated continuously and mapped across frameworks.
levels.platform: Automated governance gates and live compliance visibility.

levels.name: Measurable
levels.traits: Governance performance is tracked through metrics and SLAs. Control effectiveness is monitored in real time, and board reporting is automated.
levels.platform: Audit-ready by design, with live posture scoring.

levels.name: Adaptive
levels.summary: Governance is built in from the start.
levels.traits: New systems inherit governance the moment they are provisioned. The organisation adapts to regulatory shifts without an operational crisis.
levels.platform: Self-healing compliance and continuous risk mitigation.

check.title: How AI-governance ready is your organisation?
check.lead: Answer six questions, one for each dimension of the Governance Readiness™ score. Pick the answer closest to how things work today. Your score builds as you go.

dimensions.name: AI Inventory
dimensions.question: Do you know every AI system in use across the organisation?
options: No. Teams adopt AI tools and vendor APIs on their own.
We have an initial inventory, put together by hand.
Systems are registered as part of our development and deployment pipelines.
The inventory is tracked with metrics, and gaps are reported.
New systems inherit governance automatically when they are provisioned.
dimensions.focus: Build one register of every model, agent and vendor API, so shadow AI has nowhere to hide.

dimensions.name: AI Literacy
dimensions.question: How well do your people understand AI risk and their part in governing it?
options: Awareness is informal. People learn as they go.
Guidelines exist, but training is optional.
Role-based training is part of how teams build and deploy AI.
Training and understanding are measured and reported.
Learning keeps pace with new regulation and new AI capabilities.
dimensions.focus: Give leaders and teams a shared understanding of AI risk, regulation and their own responsibilities.

dimensions.name: Policy Coverage
dimensions.question: Do you know which rules apply to your AI, and are they written down?
options: We haven't mapped which regulations apply to us.
Policies and ethical guidelines exist in documents, followed voluntarily.
Policies are mapped to frameworks like the EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001, and applied in delivery.
Policy coverage is measured across every production system.
We adapt to regulatory shifts without an operational scramble.
dimensions.focus: Map which obligations apply to your AI portfolio, then close the gaps against each framework.

dimensions.name: Risk Assessment
dimensions.question: How do you handle high-risk uses of AI?
options: Case by case, usually after something goes wrong.
Some systems are assessed, separately by each team.
Every system is classified and assessed before it goes live.
Risk is scored quantitatively and tracked over time.
Risk is mitigated continuously as systems and regulations change.
dimensions.focus: Score each system across privacy, bias, security, accuracy, safety and legal liability before it ships.

dimensions.name: Control Effectiveness
dimensions.question: Who keeps AI in check once it is running?
options: Nobody in particular. Oversight is reactive.
Owners are named, but enforcement is voluntary.
Automated governance gates stop systems that don't meet policy.
Control effectiveness is monitored in real time, against SLAs.
Controls correct themselves when something drifts.
dimensions.focus: Turn voluntary rules into automated governance gates that run inside your delivery pipeline.

dimensions.name: Evidence Readiness
dimensions.question: If an auditor asked tomorrow, could you prove compliance?
options: No. We would be starting from scratch.
Some documents exist, but gathering them would be a project of its own.
Evidence is generated continuously and mapped to several frameworks.
We are audit-ready by design, and board reporting is automated.
Evidence and posture stay current without anyone chasing them.
dimensions.focus: File each piece of evidence once and credit it against every framework it satisfies.
